title: Agentic Workflows on Vertex AI: Rukma Sen
talk_summary: Rukma Sen gives a high-level Google Cloud talk defining agents as model plus tools plus orchestration, and contrasts deterministic, generative, and hybrid agents. She sketches single- versus multi-agent architectures with dispatcher, specialist, and supervisor roles, then pitches Vertex AI/Model Garden/Agent Builder.

takeaways.what_they_do: Use a triage agent to route work to domain specialists, then a supervisor agent to QA outputs against a predefined dataset.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a supervisor agent that quality checks the work against a predefined data set

takeaways.what_they_do: Classify fixed-rule steps as deterministic agents/scripts and reserve generative agents for open-ended work; hybrid agents combine both.
takeaways.evidence_quote: deterministic agents are basically following a fixed set of rules or algorithms to make decisions

takeaways.what_they_do: Run eval workflows to match a model to a specific use case before using it in production routing.
takeaways.evidence_quote: model eval workflows that you can run to try to match the model to your specific use case
